children: Gollagunta will evaluate a potential new business opportunity, reporting directly to Group CEO Anish Shah

Mahindra & Mahindra has appointed Nalinikant Gollagunta, currently Chief Executive Officer of its Automotive Division, as Executive Vice-President and Head of Corporate Development at the Mahindra Group, effective 1 April 2027. In his new role, Gollagunta will be tasked with evaluating and developing a potential strategic growth opportunity for the group.

Gollagunta will be based at the group's Worli office in Mumbai and report to Anish Shah, Group Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director. The appointment comes as Mahindra looks to identify another significant avenue for growth beyond its existing businesses.

Shah has indicated that the group is exploring a potentially significant new growth opportunity that will require focused evaluation. The proposed initiative will be assessed against criteria including Mahindra's ability to establish a strong competitive advantage, achieve meaningful scale and deliver returns above industry benchmarks.

Gollagunta has been leading Mahindra's Automotive Division as CEO since April 2023. His tenure has coincided with the company's push to strengthen its position in the sports utility vehicle (SUV) market and expand its electric vehicle portfolio.

He brings more than 22 years of professional experience across India, the United States and Southeast Asia. Before joining Mahindra in 2023, he held positions at General Electric, Cisco, McKinsey and Texas Instruments. His experience spans commercial leadership and business operations across emerging and mature markets.
The move will take him from leading one of the group's key operating businesses to a group-level role focused on assessing and developing potential new growth opportunities.

The transition is part of a wider leadership realignment within Mahindra's Automotive Business, also taking effect on 1 April 2027.Shuchi Suri, currently Executive Vice-President – Mahindra Experiences, will take over as Chief Sales and Marketing Officer – Automotive Business. She will oversee sales, marketing, customer care, charging infrastructure and accessories, and report to R Velusamy, President – Automotive Business.

The changes bring several customer-facing functions under Suri's leadership as Gollagunta moves to the group's corporate development function.Mahindra has not disclosed the sector or nature of the new strategic opportunity that Gollagunta will evaluate. The company has also not announced a successor to him as CEO of the Automotive Division.
